CustomField.description: Formula field to control visibility of Create Loanapp button
CustomField.formula: AND( TEXT(StageName) = "Needs Analysis", ISBLANK( Loanapp_Reference__c ), Amount > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(TPMI__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Expected_Settlement_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Servicing_Branch__c)), OR( TEXT(Customer_Needs__c) = "Home Loan - Bridging Finance", TEXT(Customer_Needs__c) = "Home Loan - Refinance", TEXT(Customer_Needs__c) = "Home Loan - Refinance + Purchase", TEXT(Customer_Needs__c) = "Home Loan - Construction", TEXT(Customer_Needs__c) = "Home Loan - Purchase", TEXT(Customer_Needs__c) = "Home Loan - Other" ) )
CustomField.label: Can Create Loanapp
